En route by train, Stourley and Louisa conceive a much-wanted child -- but Stourley's obsession with his wife's expanding belly, her perceived infidelity, and his own recurrent bouts of abdominal pain reach epic and dangerous proportions.

programme.title: The Malta Story
programme.desc: During World War II, British photo-reconnaissance pilot Peter (Alec Guinness) discovers that the Italians are planning a secret invasion of Malta, a strategically important island nation critical to keeping the Allied supply lines open. Though they have few resources left, Peter and his commanding officer, Frank (Jack Hawkins), resolve to fight off the enemy and save the island. At the same time, Peter struggles to keep his relationship with a local girl from falling apart.

programme.title: Pocketful of Miracles
programme.desc: Beggar Apple Annie (Bette Davis) learns that her daughter, escorted by an aristocratic suitor, plans to visit. It's great news -- except that she has tricked her daughter into believing she is a wealthy socialite. Fearing her true identity will disappoint, Annie petitions a superstitious mobster (Glenn Ford), who thinks the apples she sells are lucky, for help. Hesitant at first, the mafioso is persuaded by his girlfriend (Hope Lange) to disguise Annie, if only long enough to fool her daughter.

programme.title: Crime of Passion
programme.desc: When newspaper columnist Kathy Ferguson (Barbara Stanwyck) meets cop Bill Doyle (Sterling Hayden), the two quickly hit it off and get married. Kathy gives up her career and heads to Los Angeles with Bill to settle down. The homemaker lifestyle doesn't suit Kathy, however, and she becomes bored with her life and resentful toward Bill because he doesn't share her drive for success. She then secretly decides to make major moves to further Bill's career -- even if it means murdering his rivals.

programme.title: Cloudburst
programme.desc: Canadian World War II veteran John Graham (Robert Preston) works in London as a code breaker. Tragedy strikes when his pregnant wife, Carol (Elizabeth Sellars), is accidentally run over by two crooks who are speeding away from the scene of a murder. Haunted, grieving and thirsting for revenge, Graham sets out to find the two fugitive murderers. When he does, he intends to kill them, the same way they killed Carol. But will that assuage his grief?

programme.title: The Woman in the Window
programme.desc: With his family packed off to Maine, Professor Richard Wanley is anticipating some quiet time alone. Under pressure from both out-of-town gangster Kogan (Jacques Aubuchon), who wants a piece of the local action, and Treasury agent Barrett (Gene Barry), who wants to destroy the moonshine business, Luke fights for his fast-fading way of life.

programme.title: The Gallant Hours
programme.desc: As he retires from the U.S. Navy, Admiral William J. Halsey (James Cagney) recalls the most daunting challenge in his career: the Battle of Guadalcanal in 1942. Ordered to replace a close friend as fleet admiral, Halsey faces a wily and fierce adversary in Japan's Admiral Yamamoto, and spends the grueling months of the campaign confounding expectations of both the enemy and his own staff. Pained by the losses he knows they will endure, Halsey pushes his forces to the brink.

programme.title: Foreign Intrigue
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his millionaire boss, Dave Bishop (Robert Mitchum) begins a quest to discover the source of his mysterious employer's wealth. On a journey that will take Bishop across the European continent, life-threatening encounters lurk around every corner. As Bishop soon finds out, his boss acquired his wealth through underhanded schemes and blackmail. Now that their blackmailer is dead, those who are free want to keep Bishop from taking his place.

programme.title: The Devil's Brigade

Alan Crown (Cliff Robertson) leading the Canadians and Maj. Cliff Bricker (Vince Edwards) the acting head of the American contingent, there is initial tension -- but the team comes together when given a daunting mission that few would dare to attempt.

programme.title: The File of the Golden Goose
programme.desc: A U.S. agent (Yul Brynner) and a Scotland Yard man (Edward Woodward) infiltrate a forgery ring run by someone called the Owl.

programme.title: The Captive City
programme.desc: A private investigator informs small-town newspaper editor Jim Austin of corrupt local activity. When the investigator is killed, Austin believes it's an act of revenge, and his own detective work reveals a network of gambling and corruption. Crime boss Murray Sirak controls the whole town, including the police. Sirak answers to his own boss, "Mr. Big," who is seemingly untouchable, but Austin risks his life to expose the truth.

programme.title: The Russians Are Coming, the Russians Are Coming
programme.desc: When a Soviet submarine gets stuck on a sandbar off the coast of a New England island, its commander (Theodore Bikel) orders his second-in-command, Lieutenant Rozanov (Alan Arkin), to get them moving again before there is an international incident. Rozanov seeks assistance from the island locals, including the police chief (Brian Keith) and a vacationing television writer (Carl Reiner), while trying to allay their fears of a Communist invasion by claiming he and his crew are Norwegian sailors.

programme.title: Thunder Road
programme.desc: Unrepentant Tennessee moonshine runner Luke Doolin (Robert Mitchum) makes dangerous high-speed deliveries for his liquor-producing father, Vernon (Trevor Bardette), but won't let his younger brother Robin (James Mitchum) join the family business. Under pressure from both out-of-town gangster Kogan (Jacques Aubuchon), who wants a piece of the local action, and Treasury agent Barrett (Gene Barry), who wants to destroy the moonshine business, Luke fights for his fast-fading way of life.

programme.title: The Gallant Hours
programme.desc: As he retires from the U.S. Navy, Admiral William J. Halsey (James Cagney) recalls the most daunting challenge in his career: the Battle of Guadalcanal in 1942. Ordered to replace a close friend as fleet admiral, Halsey faces a wily and fierce adversary in Japan's Admiral Yamamoto, and spends the grueling months of the campaign confounding expectations of both the enemy and his own staff. Pained by the losses he knows they will endure, Halsey pushes his forces to the brink.

programme.title: Foreign Intrigue
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his millionaire boss, Dave Bishop (Robert Mitchum) begins a quest to discover the source of his mysterious employer's wealth. On a journey that will take Bishop across the European continent, life-threatening encounters lurk around every corner. As Bishop soon finds out, his boss acquired his wealth through underhanded schemes and blackmail. Now that their blackmailer is dead, those who are free want to keep Bishop from taking his place.

programme.title: The Devil's Brigade
programme.desc: At the onset of World War II, American Lt. Col. Robert Frederick (William Holden) is put in charge of a unit called the 1st Special Service Force, composed of elite Canadian commandos and undisciplined American soldiers. With Maj. programme.title: 99 River Street
programme.desc: Cab driver and ex-boxer Ernie (John Payne) discovers his wife Pauline (Peggie Castle) has been cheating on him. Ernie is approached by actress friend Linda (Evelyn Keyes), who says that she needs his help because she killed a man during an audition. After rushing to the theater, Ernie discovers that Linda's desperate tale was the audition. As if that humiliation isn't enough, Ernie is then framed for Pauline's murder by her lover, jewel thief Victor Rawlins (Brad Dexter).

programme.title: The Tiger's Tail
programme.desc: Liam O'Leary (Brendan Gleeson) is a prosperous real estate tycoon who lives in Dublin with his wife, Jane (Kim Cattrall). Hoping to bring his profits and his career to new heights, Liam takes out a large bank loan with the prospect of building a new stadium. But, when his request for development is turned down by the city, his life stumbles into a downward spiral. More disturbing than his crippled assets is his mysterious double whom he keeps seeing around town.

programme.title: House of 1,000 Dolls
programme.desc: A magician (Vincent Price) and his assistant (Martha Hyer) lure women from the audience into white slavery in Tangier.

programme.title: Crime Against Joe
programme.desc: Joe, an unemployed artist living with his mother, is suspected of murdering bar singer Irene Crescent during a drinking binge. His alibi -- that he ran into a sleepwalker and helped her home -- is denied by the sleepwalker's father. A friend, waitress Slacks, who is secretly in love with him, comes to his aid with a false alibi. When it doesn't hold up, Joe and Slacks must go in search of the real killer themselves.

programme.title: Mademoiselle
programme.desc: After a series of buildings catch fire, the residents of a small country town are quick to accuse Italian lumberjack Manou (Ettore Manni), who's already guilty of seducing most of the town's women. No one suspects the real culprit, seemingly frigid schoolmarm Mademoiselle (Jeanne Moreau), who, beneath her quiet exterior, hides a torrential sadism. She continues to commit countless random and anonymous crimes, all in a misguided attempt to draw Manou's attention to herself.

programme.title: The Fearmakers
programme.desc: After two years as a Korean War POW, Alan Eaton (Dana Andrews) returns home, where the Washington, D.C., PR firm he co-founded was sold to Jim McGinnis (Dick Foran) just before Alan's partner died in a car accident. Invited to stay as a consultant, Alan grows suspicious when his friend Sen. Walder (Roy Gordon) tells him he suspects the company has become a propaganda outlet. Fearing his partner may have been murdered, Alan discovers McGinnis is behind an anti-nuclear-power communist plot.

programme.title: The Fortune Cookie
programme.desc: While taping a football game, cameraman Harry Hinkle (Jack Lemmon) ends up slightly injured after a collision with star player "Boom Boom" Jackson (Ron Rich). When Hinkle's scheming brother-in-law, lawyer Willie Gingrich (Walter Matthau), catches wind of the incident, he wants Hinkle to feign paralysis to scam the insurance company. Hinkle agrees to the plan, if only to win back his ex (Judi West). But Hinkle's growing friendship with a guilt-ridden Jackson has him questioning the ploy.

programme.title: The Miracle Worker
programme.desc: Blind and deaf after suffering a terrible fever as a baby, young Helen Keller (Patty Duke) has spent years unable to communicate, leaving her frustrated and occasionally violent. As a last chance before she is institutionalized, her parents (Inga Swenson, Andrew Prine) contact a school for the blind, which sends half-blind Annie Sullivan (Anne Bancroft) to teach Helen. Helen is initially resistant, but Annie gradually forms a bond with her and shows Helen ways of reaching others.

programme.title: Sketch Artist
programme.desc: Struggling artist Jack Whitfield (Jeff Fahey) has just joined the Los Angeles Police Department as a sketch artist. When a famous fashion designer is killed, Jack interviews a witness named Daisy (Drew Barrymore). She describes a woman leaving the crime scene who is unmistakably Jack's wife, Rayanne (Sean Young). Scared, Jack draws an entirely different woman and tries to find the murderer on his own. But when Daisy is killed, Jack becomes a suspect.

programme.title: Kiss Me, Stupid
programme.desc: When popular singer Dino (Dean Martin) stops for gas in a small town near Las Vegas, mechanic Barney (Cliff Osmond) disables his car. Barney, who writes songs with local teacher Orville (Ray Walston), wants Dino to sing some of their compositions. Orville invites Dino over, but sends his wife, Zelda (Felicia Farr), away so Dino can't hit on her. He then hires prostitute Polly (Kim Novak) to play his wife. Meanwhile, Zelda goes to a bar, where she gets drunk and eventually meets a lonely Dino.

programme.title: Hannibal Brooks
programme.desc: A British prisoner of war is assigned to take care of an elephant in a zoo. Along with an American and an Austrian he escapes with the elephant and heads for the Swiss border. They use the elephant to gain access across the border. A Polish girl betrays them and aligns herself with the Nazis.

programme.title: Blue State
programme.desc: In the days leading up to the 2004 U.S. presidential election, political activist John Logue (Breckin Meyer) makes an inebriated pledge: He'll move to Canada if George W. Bush is reelected. When the unthinkable happens, John decides to own up to his promise. With the help of the group "Marry a Canadian," John joins forces with another aspiring ex-pat, Chloe (Anna Paquin), for a road trip up north during which they talk politics, life and, eventually, love.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: High Spirits
programme.desc: Irish hotelier Peter Plunkett attempts to fill the chronic vacancies at his castle by launching an advertising campaign that wrongly portrays the property as haunted. Unfortunately, he fails to scare a single American tourist with his hokey and dreadfully unconvincing effects. When two actual ghosts, Mary and Martin, show up to add some authenticity, they end up falling for two guests, Sharon and Jack.

programme.title: Number One With a Bullet
programme.desc: Detectives Barzak and Hazeltine are trying their hardest to bring down a drug ring, but they're meeting with trouble at every turn, which leads the officers to suspect a mole in their midst. When the detectives are dissuaded by their superiors from following a lead about the man behind the whole operation, Barzak and Hazeltine are forced to find the truth on their own without the support of their department.

programme.title: The Limbic Region
programme.desc: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. Although the case is long closed, obsessed detective Jon Lucca (Edward James Olmos) still suspects the wrong man was named as the killer. Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession.

programme.title: The Ambush Murders
programme.desc: A white lawyer (James Brolin) defends an activist (Dorian Harewood) accused of killing two policemen in a racially tense town.

programme.title: Deadly Intent
programme.desc: An adventurer's boss (Maud Adams) and other villains want his widow (Lisa Eilbacher) to lead them to his South American jewels.

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children.

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Richard "Cochise" Morris (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs), a local basketball hero, and Leroy "Preach" Jackson (Glynn Turman), who dreams of a career in writing, are likable Chicago high school students in Chicago in the 1960s. They're into hanging out with friends, pretty girls and the Motown sounds so popular during the era. Each wants to make it big in his own way, but not everybody they meet is looking out for them, as they learn when a seemingly harmless outing goes awry.

programme.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
programme.desc: Disappointed with her small part in the chorus line of a Los Angeles show, jazz dancer Kelly (Lucinda Dickey) quits and heads home. Her father (John Christy Ewing) disapproves of Kelly's friendship with street dancers Ozone (Adolfo "Shabba-Doo" Quinones) and Turbo (Michael "Boogaloo Shrimp" Chambers), and encourages her to pursue an opportunity to perform in Paris. Ignoring his wishes, Kelly teams up with her friends for a break-dancing benefit show to save an endangered community center.

programme.title: Rappin'
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music.

programme.title: Beat Street
programme.desc: At the forefront of early hip-hop culture, DJ Kenny Kirkland (Guy Davis), his B-boy brother, Lee (Robert Taylor), and graffiti artist Ramon (John Chardiet) all have hopes of showcasing their talents outside the confines of South Bronx, N.Y. When Tracy Carlson (Rae Dawn Chong), a composer and choreographer, runs into Kirkland and Lee at one of Manhattan's hottest nightclubs, she offers Lee an opportunity to perform on TV. However, the crew has a long way to go before achieving their dreams.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Hurricane Streets
programme.desc: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico.

programme.title: Crack House
programme.desc: Rick (Gregg Thomsen) and Melissa (Cheryl Kay) are two young lovebirds struggling against the crime and poverty of the Los Angeles ghetto they inhabit. Their hopes of ever leaving are destroyed when one of Rick's relatives is killed in a drive-by shooting. Seeking to avenge the vicious murder, Rick rejoins his former gang, but gets himself arrested. During his absence, Melissa becomes involved with drug dealers and is addicted to crack. Rick then sets out on a difficult mission to save her.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico.

programme.title: The Perez Family
programme.desc: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily.

programme.title: Odds Against Tomorrow
programme.desc: Disgraced former police officer David Burke (Ed Begley) is looking for a way to make some quick money. When he decides to rob a bank, he calls on mean ex-con Earle Slater (Robert Ryan) and black entertainer Johnny Ingram (Harry Belafonte) to help him pull off the heist. Johnny is reluctant to agree but is forced to reconsider because of his significant gambling debts, while racist Earle balks because of Johnny's involvement. Ultimately, though, they must work together to get the job done.

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman) is a rich cattle rancher. He has a bad relationship with his wife, Melissa (Candice Bergen), whom he treats like a possession. While Brandt is away from home on a hunting trip, Frank Calder (Oliver Reed), a brazen outlaw, kidnaps Melissa and holds her for ransom. Frank, however, treats Melissa better than her own husband does, and before long she begins to develop feelings for him. When Brandt returns, he's enraged and vows to take violent revenge against Frank.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: Jake Remy (Warren Oates) and his band of mercenaries shoot their way through a tiny border town, planning to escape with their plunder across the river into Mexico. They dispatch a few men to neutralize the local ferryman, Travis (Lee Van Cleef), but he and flinty mountain man Phil (Forrest Tucker) foil the scheme. By the time Jake reaches the river, Travis has already taken everyone from the town to the Mexican side. He refuses passage to the mercenaries, and a lengthy standoff ensues.

programme.title: The Return of Sabata
programme.desc: The third in a trilogy about the eponymous lone gunman, this one finds Sabata (Lee Van Cleef) working as a sharpshooter for a circus that's just stopped in an ailing one-horse town. The circus gig is only a front, however: Sabata is actually on the verge of robbing town mayor Joe McIntock (Giampiero Albertini). The mayor's been levying heavy taxes as part of a complex plan to defraud the community, but Sabata manages to rip him off first, only to discover that the money is counterfeit.

programme.title: The Utah Kid
programme.desc: A lawman and a rodeo rider go after a gang that's been bribing and doping rodeo contestants to affect the outcome and make a bundle of cash.

programme.title: Bandera Bandits

programme.title: Powderkeg
programme.desc: A pair of troubleshooting investigators must help recover a hijacked train that has 73 hostages aboard.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: Barbara Leighton (Marian Carr) travels by stagecoach to a small frontier town, the home of her fiancé, Duff Dailey (John Smith). When Dailey and miner Kerry "Crusty" McCabe (William Phillips) find the coach station ransacked by dangerous Cheyenne fighters, they board the stagecoach and swear to protect Leighton and the rest of the passengers. As the Cheyenne close in, the weary travelers hole up at a saloon in a nearby ghost town -- and prepare for the longest night of their lives.

programme.title: High Noon, Part II: The Return of Will Kane
programme.desc: A retired sheriff (Lee Majors) has a showdown with the bad bounty hunter (Pernell Roberts) who replaced him.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: After the Civil War, rancher Thomas Dunson (James Arness) leads a dangerous cattle drive across Texas with a team that includes his adopted son, Matthew (Bruce Boxleitner), and black cowboy Jack Byrd (Stan Shaw), whose presence annoys some of the white cowboys. Fearful of Indians and struggling through the dry terrain, Dunson's men grow increasingly unhappy with his authoritarian ways. Fed up, rebellious Matthew goes to work for another ranch, infuriating his father.

programme.title: Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: In this 19th-century drama, an American family from the Northeast heads to Wyoming in search of a better life, only to face tragedy and hardship. Maggie Sergent (Joanna Pettet), the hard-driving matriarch of the clan, is totally unprepared when her husband, John (William Shatner), is murdered. Left to handle the farm on her own, Maggie must choose whether to stay in Wyoming and run the farm with her children, or head back to the East Coast and the life she knows.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three
programme.desc: Bank robber Graham Dorsey spends a few hours with beautiful widow Amanda Starbuck, in which time his gang takes part in a disastrous holdup. Learning of his comrades' demise, Dorsey goes on the lam. Believing her short-term lover was killed by the law, Amanda decides to make the most of having had a liaison with the supposedly deceased desperado by writing a book about him. Much to his confusion, the still-living Dorsey watches as his name becomes legendary.

programme.title: Captain John Smith and Pocahontas
programme.desc: Back in England after his trip to Jamestown, Va., Capt. John Smith (Anthony Dexter) tells the tale of his journey, particularly his lost romance with Native American maiden Pocahontas (Jody Lawrence). They meet and gradually fall for each other when captured Smith is saved from certain death by the girl. But as Smith tries to maintain peace between the British colonists and local tribes, the task proves harrowing, and Smith's friend Rolfe (Robert Clarke) begins to move in on Pocahontas.

programme.title: Grayeagle
programme.desc: One day while reputable trapper John Colter (Ben Johnson) is away from home, his adoring daughter Beth (Lana Wood) is captured by the notorious Indian Grayeagle (Alex Cord). But, as her father begins his tireless search to recover her, Beth is surprised to discover that there is more to Grayeagle than his fearsome reputation would imply. As she grows to realize that he is a man of honor -- much like her father -- she begins to fall in love with this proud Cheyenne warrior.

programme.title: The Yellow Tomahawk
programme.desc: After commanding the brutal slaughter of a Cheyenne tribe, callous cavalry leader Maj. Ives (Warner Anderson) then orders the construction of a military base on Native American territory. While the surviving Cheyenne men plot their revenge, warrior Fireknife (Lee Van Cleef) contacts his friend cavalry scout Adam Reed (Rory Calhoun), and warns him of the bloodbath that will occur if Ives doesn't retreat from the area. Reed passes on the message, which falls on deaf ears, and chaos ensues.

programme.title: The Iroquois Trail

programme.title: War Drums
programme.desc: Mangas Coloradas (Lex Barker), an Apache chief, and white trader Luke Fargo (Ben Johnson) are bound by friendship and their mutual love for Riva (Joan Taylor), a Mexican-Native American girl rescued from horse thieves. When Fargo, who did not intend an attack, is injured, Riva helps him -- a kindness he must choose whether or not to return when war with the Apaches erupts.

This motley crew's path is difficult, and they face many obstacles, not the least of which is nasty frontiersman Stan Bodine (Walter Matthau).

programme.desc: Rich Eisen leads a cast of NFL talent through four hours of pregame hype, prepping viewers for the kickoffs of Sunday's games. programme.title: NFL GameDay Live
programme.desc: Expanding on NFL Network's "GameDay" programming on Sundays during football season, "GameDay Live" updates viewers on what's happening throughout the league. Beginning with kickoff of early-afternoon events and continuing throughout late-afternoon contests, the studio show offers nearly immediate highlights of scoring and other notable plays. But the program is about more than the action; it intersperses highlights of press conferences, interviews with players and coaches, and live reports by announcers at game sites.

programme.title: Live: Hot Stove
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: MLB Tonight
programme.desc: When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster that includes former players Eric Byrnes, Al Leiter, Dan Plesac, Billy Ripken and Mike Lowell, and inside information men Tom Verducci, Jon Heyman, Peter Gammons and Ken Rosenthal. Greg Amsinger, Brian Kenny and Matt Vasgersian are among the hosts.

programme.desc: Pushing the limits on legendary ground. Lena Chin takes on the iconic hills and high-speed thrills of Lime Rock Park at GRIDLIFE Circuit Legends, navigating the intense pressure and physical challenges of battling at the absolute pointy end of the GLTC field.

programme.title: Gridlives
programme.desc: The mental toll of the championship hunt. James Houghton battles for a win at a new track while confronting the extreme highs and lows of competition. It's an unfiltered look at the questions every driver faces when the helmet comes off-because for these racers, it isn't just a sport; it's who they are.

programme.title: Lost Classics
programme.desc: Tony helps an owner move a custom Mercury to none other than Joe Zolper as a potential buyer; a lead sends Tony to a dusty garage hiding a nearly untouched Porsche RS America with just 5,000 original miles.

programme.title: Off-Road Travel TV

programme.desc: Our Ken Faught and Viola Bautista go overlanding on the Garden Island of Kauai. Our team also rides dirt bikes and drives UTVs in Costa Rica and tests Yamaha's impressive 700cc Tenere adventure bike.

programme.title: 2026 Best of GAA Classic Car Auctions

programme.title: Sam's Garage

programme.title: SEMA Battle of the Builders

programme.desc: "My Big Fat Fabulous Life" follows Whitney Thore's emotional journey after being diagnosed with polycystic ovarian syndrome. The disorder caused Whitney, a slender dancer at the time, to gain more than 200 pounds in one year at college. Feeling trapped in a big body, she struggled with self-doubt and negative stereotypes. Now 380 pounds and eager to continue sharing her passion for dance, Whitney has learned to embrace her body and love herself again. She teaches dance classes for plus-size girls, explores the dating scene, confronts bullies, and wears a bikini on the beach for the first time in 10 years. She also spearheads a campaign that fights body-shaming and promotes self-love and acceptance. To that end, Whitney Thore is no longer letting her fear of people's judgment dictate the way she lives her life.

programme.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
programme.desc: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Casos de familia
programme.desc: Personas comunes y corrientes se reúnen en el escenario para exponer sus historias reales y dramas personales, ellos comentan sus casos ante la audiencia presente y ante el público televidente. La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.title: La red
programme.desc: Los chismes, la información más detallada y exclusiva de los famosos de la farándula y lo que está sucediendo en el mundo del entretenimiento, son transmitidos en este espacio en la que los periodistas, presentadores del programa, revelan lo más íntimo y secreto de las estrellas y sus escándalos. A ellos no se les escapa nadie, las fotografías, vídeos y hasta correos electrónicos son usados para obtener la información de primera plana. Los televidentes también tienen la oportunidad de participar en el programa enviando material valioso sobre sus estrellas favoritas y hasta pueden llegar a ser remunerados.

programme.title: Sábados felices
programme.desc: El legendario programa televisivo más reconocido, aclamado y querido por los colombianos, que ya hace parte de la cultura del país y que ha divertido y entretenido a varias generaciones, presenta en sus segmentos característicos, una gama variada de estilos de comedia, cuenta chistes, parodias originales, caracterizaciones de importantes personalidades del país y personalidades internacionales, cuenteros y troveros. Esta serie creada por su anfitrión Alfonso Lizarazo, le ha dado la oportunidad a talentos desconocidos de llegar al estrellato, este espacio ha sido una plataforma para los que han sido aclamados como los mejores comediantes del país. El programa además apoya obras sociales y ha ayudado a recaudar recursos monetarios que han contribuido a construir muchos centros estudiantiles.

Todos ellos viven en Jammbo, un planeta en donde se origina la música del universo. programme.title: Jelly Jamm
programme.desc: Serie de animación en 3D dirigida a los niños en edad preescolar, la cual narra las divertidas aventuras de cinco amigos: Bello, Mina, Rita, Goomo y Ongo. Todos ellos viven en Jammbo, un planeta en donde se origina la música del universo. Para que todos los habitantes del planeta Jammbo puedan vivir, es necesario que la fábrica de música produzca música continuamente a través de burbujas. Si la fábrica dejara de trabajar Bello y sus amigos quedarían suspendidos sin poder moverse.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm
programme.desc: Serie de animación en 3D dirigida a los niños en edad preescolar, la cual narra las divertidas aventuras de cinco amigos: Bello, Mina, Rita, Goomo y Ongo. Todos ellos viven en Jammbo, un planeta en donde se origina la música del universo. Para que todos los habitantes del planeta Jammbo puedan vivir, es necesario que la fábrica de música produzca música continuamente a través de burbujas. Si la fábrica dejara de trabajar Bello y sus amigos quedarían suspendidos sin poder moverse.

Si la fábrica dejara de trabajar Bello y sus amigos quedarían suspendidos sin poder moverse.

programme.title: Por siempre mi amor
programme.desc: Alejandro planea enamorar a Aranza para poder estar cerca de Isabel. Daniel le confiesa su amor a Marianela. Aranza y Dafne encuentran a Iliana abrazando a Esteban. Aranza malinterpreta las cosas.

programme.title: Por siempre mi amor
programme.desc: Isabel recibe un mensaje en su celular que la altera mucho porque cree que es de Fernando. Isabel se pone muy mal, Aranza la lleva al hospital, pero en el trayecto tiene un accidente.

programme.title: Por siempre mi amor
programme.desc: Sonia se molesta con Fernando por haber puesto en peligro a Aranza. Isabel le dice a Arturo que podría perder a su hijo.

programme.title: Por siempre mi amor
programme.desc: El hijo de Isabel y Arturo no logra salvarse. Arturo se entera de que alguien provocó el accidente de Isabel y Aranza. Javier planea una cena romántica para Aranza y le pide que sea su novia.

programme.title: Por siempre mi amor
programme.desc: Isabel no puede aceptar la muerte de su bebé y decide suicidarse. Javier cada vez está más cerca de Isabel, pero ella no lo reconoce.

programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: La llamaban La Madrina
programme.desc: Trini, la hermosa hija del señor Baldomero, dotada por la madre naturaleza de unas excepcionales cualidades en el difícil arte de reventar cajas fuertes y otros ingenios por el estilo, decidió hace ya tiempo convertirse en amante de la ley, renunciando a su virtuosismo y hasta mudándose de barrio. En esta nueva vida, incluso se colocó de cajera en un supermercado y se echó un novio estudiante de leyes.

programme.title: Un paraguas para tres
programme.desc: María y Daniel se conocen en una tienda poco después de separarse de sus respectivas parejas. Después del primer encuentro siguen encontrándose varias veces, cosa que adjudican al destino. Los dos se sienten atraídos, pero nadie da el primer paso.

programme.title: ¿De qué se ríen las mujeres?
programme.desc: Luci, Graci y Mari son tres hermanas que conforman un trío cómico y asisten a la boda de su padre con una mujer cuarenta y cinco años más joven que él. Durante el banquete, Carlos, el marido de Luci, muere repentinamente. Ella, por una casualidad, encuentra una agenda y descubre que su marido le era infiel con varias mujeres. A partir de ese momento, el único objetivo de Luci es salir con todo hombre que encuentre.

programme.title: La Celestina

programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

programme.title: Vocación Sexo
programme.desc: Un día en la vida de un productor pornográfico vista desde sus propios ojos, filmado en cámara subjetiva. La historia y los problemas se inician cuando Dalton se despierta a mediodía y recibe una llamada telefónica de su equipo de grabación, avisándole que una actriz pornográfica había abandonado el set.

programme.title: Discriminación
programme.desc: En el siniestro negocio del tráfico humano, una organización criminal se dedica a la explotación de mujeres, convirtiéndolas en esclavas sexuales.

La serie se transmite en tres ediciones nocturnas, luego se re-transmite la última edición cuatro veces cada mañana de lunes a viernes antes de despejar el escenario para un bloque de seis horas de "SportsCenter" en vivo, que pone más énfasis en la interactividad de los fanáticos, noticias, análisis, comentarios y la cobertura de las conferencias de prensa.

programme.title: जीन्स
programme.sub-title: Madhumita and Vishwanathan fall in love with each other but his father disapproves of the relationship as he wants his twin sons to marry two identical twins
programme.desc: मधुमिता और विश्वनाथन एक-दूसरे से प्यार करते हैं लेकिन विश्वनाथन के पिता इस रिश्ते को अस्वीकार कर देते हैं क्योंकि वह चाहते हैं कि उनके जुड़वां बेटे जुड़वां लड़कियों से शादी करे।.

programme.title: विधाता
programme.sub-title: After the death of his parent, Kunal lives with his grandfather Shamsher. However, when he falls in love with Durga, Shamsher plans to separate them
programme.desc: कुणाल अपने माता-पिता की मौत के बाद, अपने प्रभावशाली दादा, शमशेर के साथ रहता है। वह दुर्गा के प्यार में पड़ता है, हालाँकि, शमशेर उसे अस्वीकार करता है और दोनों प्रेमियों को अलग करने की साजिश करता है।.

credits.actor: Dilip Kumar (Shamsher Singh / Shobhraj),Shammi Kapoor (Gurbaksh Singh),Sanjeev Kumar (Abu Baba),Sanjay Dutt (Kunal Singh),Padmini Kolhapure (Durga),Madan Puri (Khushaal Singh / K.K.),Amrish Puri (Jagawar Chaudhary),Suresh Oberai (Inspector Pratap Singh)

programme.title: सौतन
programme.sub-title: Shyam, a middle-class man, falls in love with a millionaire's daughter and marries her. However, as their relationship starts deteriorating, Shyam finds solace in the company of Radha
programme.desc: एक मध्यम वर्गीय व्यक्ति, श्याम, अमीर रुक्मिणी से प्यार करता है और उससे शादी करता है। हालांकि, श्याम और राधा के रिश्ते में खटास बढ़ने पर, उसकी राधा से नज़दीकियाँ बढ़ जाती हैं।.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna,Tina Munim,Padmini Kolhapure,Prem Chopra,Shashikala,Pran,Shreeram Lagoo

programme.title: डेडलाइन: सिर्फ 24 घंटे
programme.sub-title: Anishka, the daughter of a doctor, is kidnapped, and the abductors demand a hefty ransom. When Dr Viren abides by their rules and delivers the money, the kidnappers vanish with the money and Anishka
programme.desc: एक प्रसिद्ध हृदय सर्जन की बेटी का अपहरण कर फिरौती की माँग की जाती है। वह पैसे की व्यवस्था करता है और अपहर्ताओं को देता है, लेकिन वे उसकी बेटी को वापस किए बिना ही पैसे लेकर गायब हो जाते हैं।.

credits.actor: Konkona Sen Sharma (Sanjana Goenka),Irrfan Khan (Krish Vaidya),Rajit Kapoor (Dr. Viren Goenka),Sandhya Mridul (Roohi Vaidya),Jhanak Shukla (Anishka Goenka),Zakir Hussain (Kabir),Rajeev Verma (Police Commissioner Rana),Preiti (Dia)

programme.title: बटालियन 609
programme.sub-title: Indian and Pakistani armies clash verbally, leading to a cricket match challenge where territorial pride hangs in the balance
programme.desc: भारतीय और पाकिस्तानी सेनाएँ मौखिक रूप से भिड़ जाती हैं, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप एक क्रिकेट मैच की चुनौती होती है, जहाँ क्षेत्रीय गौरव दाव पर लग जाता है।.

credits.actor: Shoaib Ibrahim,Elena Kazan,Farnaz Shetty,Sunil Gupta,Ram Awana,Vishwas Kini,Jashan Singh Kohli,Vikas Srivastav

programme.title: हर दिल जो प्यार करेगा
programme.sub-title: Raj, an aspiring singer, rescues Pooja, the daughter of a wealthy man, from an accident. However, he soon finds himself in a web of complications when he falls in love with her best friend
programme.desc: राज एक दुर्घटना में पूजा को बचाता है, लेकिन वह कोमा में चली जाती है। जब वह ठीक हो जाती है और उसे राज से प्यार हो जाता है, लेकिन, तब तक राज को पूजा की सबसे अच्छी सहेली जान्हवी से प्यार हो चुका होता है।.

credits.actor: Salman Khan (Raj Sharma),Preity Zinta (Jahnvi Verma),Rani Mukerji (Pooja Oberoi),Rajeev Verma (Bharat Oberoi),Paresh Rawal (Goverdhan Verma),Neeraj Vora (Abdul),Shakti Kapoor (Abdul's uncle),Satish Shah (Mahesh Hirwani),Kamini Kaushal (Biji),Vinay Pathak (Monty)

programme.title: 雲泥 / When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: 女主角熊素素因不能接受機師男友意外身亡而患上精神分裂症，一天巧遇留學歸來的精神科醫生黎易非，多次奇幻的相遇令易非和素素捲入三角戀和複雜的內心糾結之中。.

programme.title: 血滴子 / The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: 馬騰是雍正的密令組織「血滴子特務團」的其中一位殺手。當馬騰質疑其特務行動是否有違道義時，卻旋即變成被同伴追捕的逃犯。.

programme.title: 春暖花開 / Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: 故事描述，陳太太有女潔玉及美玉，潔玉已工作，美玉仍求學。適逢陳家有空房出租，少奇來租，一談即合；潔玉三個姊姊，皆與租客結婚，所以潔玉表姊趙靜蘭之母決仿效陳家租房選婿。未幾，一醫科學生欣農來租房，趙母見他是理想快婿，忙出租。原來少奇與欣農是同學，少奇老成寡言，被潔玉、美玉視為怪人，欣農則只顧談戀愛….

programme.title: 包剪石沓 / Melody of Love
programme.desc: 幽默風趣的愛情喜劇，三個年青醫生常開道、史瑞科、蕭而可，被安排追求院長的三個女兒靈珍、靈珊、靈玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」來決定追求對象，他們的追女橋段層出不窮，用盡英雄救美、苦肉計、死纏爛打等愛情藥方，卻全部失靈，烏龍百出...

programme.title: 群英會 / Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: 本片由三個單元故事組成，為岳楓、程剛及張徹聯合執導，當年就有「花一張票價，看三套電影」的稱譽。嶽楓之〈鐵弓緣〉講述一對青年男女因一把鐵弓而結緣、程剛之〈胭脂虎〉講述一群絕色妓女的故事、張徹之〈白水灘〉講述梁山英雄後代的故事。.

programme.title: 艷陽天 / Blue Skies
programme.desc: 鋼琴師李燕南與樂隊指揮女兒陳小芸相愛，常指點她歌唱技巧。小芸在一次代替演出中一鳴驚人，得團主及花花公子杜邦傑力捧。小芸赴星馬演出，心卻惦念燕南，一夜與杜邦傑于車內發生爭執，怎料汽車失事...

programme.title: 魔劍俠情 / Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: 狄龍扮演的小李悄然回到愛侶故園之旁隱居，遙對窗中倩影，而不相見，直至發生危機，小李才露面相告，並且挺身赴難。有不少高手為爭“武林排名”而找小李決鬥，小李又要對付惡勢力龐大的幫主谷峰，於是小李找尋舊友阿飛相助，但阿飛被陰險美女林仙兒所迷，簡直變成廢人，小李於是揭破這女人的假面目，並且設法使阿飛振作起來。.

programme.title: 冰天俠女 / Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: 沈冰紅幼時目擊父母遭高允及結拜弟兄殺害，雙腳更被凍至殘廢；長大後練就非凡武功，矢志復仇。後冰紅與高允次子高天英結識，天英雖知冰紅為報仇而來，卻對她的遭遇非常同情，主動為她治好腳疾…….

programme.title: 鐵扇公主 / Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: 唐僧師徒西行取經，受阻於烈火綿延的火焰山，唯有鐵扇公主的芭蕉扇方能滅火。然而因紅孩兒一事，牛魔王夫婦拒不相助。孫悟空遂與二人展開「三調芭蕉扇」的智勇較量。越過火焰山後，師徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹設下的長生圈套。面對詭計多端的妖精，悟空再施神通，護師脫險。.

programme.title: 白蛇傳 / Madam White Snake
programme.desc: 妖精白素貞跟妹妹青青在凡間巧遇前世救命恩人書生許仙，後更以身相許給許仙。後和尚法海揭穿其身份並把這對苦命鴛鴦拆散...

programme.title: 鏢旗飛揚 / The Protectors
programme.desc: 淩霄及關望龍同為一流鏢師，深得主人器重。關單戀主人孫女方燕，方卻情系于淩。關遷怒淩，竟與黑道中人金不換密谋劫鏢，嫁禍淩...

programme.title: 鳳還巢 / Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易，庶室程夫人既憤且惱，對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥，催促二人早日成親。居易見雪雁貌醜而癡，嚇得留書出走。富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久，趁此良機冒充居易，依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角，配搭新鮮；而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出，更令人笑破肚皮。.

programme.title: 保鏢 / Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: 洛陽無敵莊莊主失去了所有功力，於是請來侄兒與未婚妻一起護送黃金前往京城。在途中，他們遇到了一名神秘俠客，三人隨即聯手對抗盜匪，竭力保護黃金不被劫走。.

programme.title: 慾燄狂流 / Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: 故事描述飾花花公子的喬莊與好友楊帆，同時愛上胡燕妮，但楊成人之美。但喬因生殖力弱，故當胡懷孕時，就懷疑妻與楊有染….

programme.title: 慾燄狂流 / Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: 故事描述飾花花公子的喬莊與好友楊帆，同時愛上胡燕妮，但楊成人之美。但喬因生殖力弱，故當胡懷孕時，就懷疑妻與楊有染….

programme.title: 奇門怪招爛頭蟀 / The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: 受到《醉拳》啟發，這部功夫喜劇描述一名傻頭傻腦的功夫小子自創了一套蟋蟀拳，其後更逐一打敗曾欺凌他的武林人士。.

programme.title: 獵人 / Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事，周丟棄劉明華，又去追獵呂綺美，劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚，呂遭殺死，警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人，一個一個的被殺死，嫌兇漸指向他，好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。.

programme.title: 蕩寇誌 / All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: 張徹導演的武俠鉅作《水滸傳》的延續。七大梁山的英雄義士為保國家，奉命征討宦官專權。展開一場轟轟烈烈之蕩寇大決戰。.

programme.title: 少林五祖 / Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: 將少林寺視為眼中釘的清廷，處心積慮地想一舉消滅少林子弟，於是火燒少林寺。事出突然，寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九。其中五名生還弟子，決意為死去的少林弟子報仇。五人潛心修煉終成正果，被後世稱為“少林五祖”。.

programme.title: 蛇王子 / The Snake Prince
programme.desc: 廣西蛇山中有三條巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇將及黃蛇將；一夜三蛇化成人形與苗寨男女載歌載舞，蛇王子更因此愛上苗寨女子黑琴。後苗寨旱災，蛇王子答應率蛇作法，引水入寨，但條件是要娶黑琴為妻...

programme.title: 插翅虎 / The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: 若結合武林兩大魔頭，插翅虎及活閻王，的武功，他們必定獨霸武林，江湖又將有一輪腥風血雨。活閻王為促成這個邪惡聯盟，決將胞妹嫁給插翅虎。究竟最後二人之毒計會否得逞？誰可挽救一場武林浩劫？.

programme.title: 瀛台泣血 / The Last Tempest
programme.desc: 清朝末年，光緒帝親政后，開始着手維新變法，惜改革觸犯了想保全自身富貴功名的官僚的阻擾。支持皇帝變法的康有為性格軟弱，堅持變法的譚嗣同難免浮躁，光緒深知自己的處境危險，於是企圖利用袁世凱去對付握有兵權的榮祿。但在關鍵時刻，袁世凱見風使舵卻向榮祿告了密，出賣了光緒...

programme.title: 飛燕金刀 / Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: 總鏢頭李志山的妻子私通對頭人龍震天，並設計先偷飛龍刀，再殺害李志山及女兒小燕，幸好最後李氏父女成功逃脫。小燕長大後，更成為武功高強的女劍客，誓要為死去的母親報仇。直至一個偶然的機會，小燕遇到仍然在生的母親，才駭然發現真相，原來自己一直被父親的謊言所蒙騙。.

programme.title: 蘭嶼之歌 / Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: 蘭嶼紅蟲為患，島上人只信大頭目及巫醫巴達兩人。年青醫生何維德到蘭嶼找尋曾到此研究紅蟲而失蹤的父親，因而與未婚妻白丹娜鬧翻。後來何與孤女雅蘭相愛，惹來西呼達嫉妒；同時何為島民治病，令巴達信眾日減，西呼達、巴達均伺機殺何，何身陷險境而不自知…….

programme.title: 廣東靚仔玉 / Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: 清廷高手駱一虎殺害反清義士陳貴，陳妻偕女小薇逃往廣龍鎮。鎮上兩家武館勢成水火，何教頭之侄家玉生性調皮，因營救小薇識破了老師為反清首領的身份。隨著至親與恩師相繼喪命於駱一虎之手，原本好勝頑皮的家玉憤而承擔起復仇重任，與清廷勢力展開生死決戰。.

programme.title: 兒女是我們的 / The Younger Generation
programme.desc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文，為了自由戀愛，脫離父母，從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活。他們生育五個兒女，但生存的擔子日重，二人長期辛勞，終相繼亡故。小兒女頓失庇蔭，直接面對複雜的社會，幾乎各散東西…….

programme.title: 盜劍 / Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: 韓九重為奪削鐵如泥的青霜劍，誘殺師弟談鶴鳴；談鶴鳴的妻子耿六娘隱姓埋名在將軍府為傭，伺機奪劍報仇。將軍女兒嬌龍拜六娘為師，練成一身武藝，並與六娘師侄羅翼虎相戀。翼虎順嬌龍之意，深夜到親王府盜劍，然而寡不敵眾，失手被擒；嬌龍率眾營救，與韓九重等人展開連場激戰。.

programme.title: 蕭十一郎 / Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: 蕭十一郎被人冒名作惡，送"割鹿刀"托連城璧殺蕭。寶刀途中被軒轅無敵奪去。軒欲強搶美女沈璧君，蕭英雄救美。蕭行蹤敗露，被連伏擊重傷，幸為沈所救。蕭決意將寶刀取回...

programme.title: 大羅劍俠 / The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: 女俠明珠的師父遭黑虎幫歹徒偷襲重傷，臨終囑往找故友之女青青，探問失蹤財寶。歹徒偷聽得遺言，先去劫走青青，途遇「大羅劍俠」周應龍，怒打不平…….

programme.title: 大羅劍俠 / The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: 女俠明珠的師父遭黑虎幫歹徒偷襲重傷，臨終囑往找故友之女青青，探問失蹤財寶。歹徒偷聽得遺言，先去劫走青青，途遇「大羅劍俠」周應龍，怒打不平…….

programme.title: 金石情 / Forever And Ever
programme.desc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋，其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿，意圖賣瘋傳毒。貞蓮將真相和盤托出，孝文感於貞蓮真情，決意回鄉稟明母親，迎接貞蓮返家。孝文走後，貞蓮萬念俱灰，竟狂飲毒酒，以圖自盡...

programme.title: 皇家大賊 / Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: 幹探周福祥的好友阿金因誤殺途人而辭職，淪為職業殺手。金所執行的多宗兇殺案中，恰巧由周負責，好友二人面臨生死決鬥...

programme.title: 茅山殭屍拳 / The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍，啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍，而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是，此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技，二人皆為深不可測的武林高手！.

programme.title: 至尊一劍 / The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: 魔山派秦五新劍術高超，連敗九十九名劍手，終在最後一擊敗在劍神手上。五新知其欠缺一柄寶劍，遂殺死著名鑄劍師老鷹，奪取稀世的「老鷹寶劍」。老鷹之子燕北悲痛萬分，矢誓報仇，不自量力挑戰五新，結果被打落懸崖之下...

programme.title: 賣命小子 / The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: 武林名門世家子弟袁鷹飛為了對付虎威鏢局少鏢頭關雲，拉攏四位失意江湖高手對付他。豈料四人與關雲不打不相識，反成好友。後袁鷹飛設下毒計害死關雲，四人悲憤交集，遂聯手為友復仇。.

programme.title: 魂斷奈何天 / Dawn will Come
programme.desc: 良才見秋容貌美，心懷不軌，竟將其迷姦。秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑，相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻。誰知數月後，良才音訊全無，秋容更發現自已懷有身孕，於是馬上去找良才。可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻，更打算將秋容滅口….

programme.title: 無名英雄 / The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: 街頭浪蕩客孟剛與鐵虎雖玩世不恭，卻心懷俠義。一次偶然，孟剛結識革命軍首領萬泰，在其感召下，兩兄弟決心投身革命。在孟剛女友的協助下，他們成功潛入軍閥陣營，智取軍火送往前線。然而，在與軍閥的激戰中，三人相繼壯烈犧牲，成為湮沒於歷史中的「無名英雄」。.

programme.title: 春火 / My Son
programme.desc: 楊國良是探長兒子，國良怪父沉迷工作，母離世仍在查案，隔膜頓生。國良遇上舞女梅琳，兩人母親皆歿，了解下迅即同居生活。國良因生活費花盡到俱樂部賭錢，被陳彪騙下巨款，更強姦梅琳。國良憤然殺死陳彪，遭警察圍捕......

programme.title: 盤絲洞 / The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: 本片為邵氏「西遊記」系列的第三部作品。唐僧落入了七位蜘蛛精的手中，希望食唐僧肉而得到永生。悟空、八戒和沙僧因此大鬧盤絲洞拯救唐僧。.

programme.title: 十三太保 / The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: 故事講述于唐朝年間，沙陀國主有十三義子，皆獲太保銜。姜大衛飾演的十三太保為戰場精英，因而引起兄弟間的嫉妒及挑撥離間，最後更演變成兄弟相殘。.

programme.title: 儒俠 / The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: 年輕劍客沈秉義受命出任愛國組織「日月會」總舵主，誓要討伐勾結外敵、禍國殃民的大將軍。在捨身報國的征途中，他先後邂逅豪爽女俠與兩位美若天仙的維族公主。面對國仇家恨與三段纏綿深情，這位劍客陷入了情義兩難的抉擇。.

programme.title: 血手印 / The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: 窮書生林肇德與富翁女兒訂親，但富翁因其家道中落而反對婚事。為迎娶摯愛，肇德上京考取功名，臨行前會晤未婚妻，怎料卻碰上婢女滿身鮮血伏屍後花園。因不慎留下血手印於門上，他更被誣陷殺人。直至包公及時重審，為他洗脫冤情。.

programme.title: 成記茶樓 / The Tea House
programme.desc: 大哥成從大陸逃到香港，在屋邨經營茶樓，本想安分守己，卻屢遭惡勢力挑釁，而警方卻袖手旁觀，迫使大哥成和茶樓的朋友們決定以牙還牙！.

programme.title: 邪鬥邪 / Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: 餘腩沉溺賭海，由於欠債累累無力償還，遂答應債主以其妻肉償債項。事件被其妻識破，並決意離餘而去。餘動輕生念頭，可最終自殺未遂。餘遇上一名富家老伯，老伯答應給餘巨額現金，只要餘答應幫他娶得美人歸...

programme.title: 邪鬥邪 / Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: 餘腩沉溺賭海，由於欠債累累無力償還，遂答應債主以其妻肉償債項。事件被其妻識破，並決意離餘而去。餘動輕生念頭，可最終自殺未遂。餘遇上一名富家老伯，老伯答應給餘巨額現金，只要餘答應幫他娶得美人歸...

programme.title: 惡虎村 / Village of Tigers
programme.desc: 九姑娘之兄巴傑勾結惡虎村惡霸胡蛟，圖劫鏢銀，被「鐵沙掌」駱宏勛打傷。胡蛟恐事發後被巴家追究，下毒將巴傑毒斃，嫁禍駱宏勛，巴家上下誓欲殺死駱報仇…….

programme.title: 怒海情仇 / Call of the Sea
programme.desc: 故事描述，青年漁夫魯金虎與漁女小玉自幼相好；土豪獨子耀祖，垂涎小玉美色，時藉故親近；一天耀祖欺負寡婦五嫂，金虎抱不平，幾動武，惹小玉誤會金虎與五嫂有不尋常關係….

programme.title: 英雄無淚 / Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: 江湖异人蕭大師鑄成寶劍「泪痕劍」，不料該劍顯現出凶兆，將會帶來武林浩劫，而他的親生子注定要死在此劍之下。蕭爲了使此劍不危害江湖，將它交給一位淡薄名利的弟子保管。數十年後該弟子把它傳給門徒小高，令其帶劍下山望化解江湖劫數。.

programme.title: 女秀才 / The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: 聞蜚蛾自幼女扮男裝從父習武，後更考得秀才功名，堪稱文武全才。同窗好友杜子中與魏撰之雖與蜚蛾日夕相對，均不知其是女兒身。聞母見女兒年紀不小，不該再扮男裝，勸蜚蛾選撰之或子中為夫婿。不料蜚娥與二人情誼相同，一時無法抉擇，遂決定由天定奪，怎知陰差陽錯，選婿之箭落於撰之手中。蜚娥後悔不已，才知自己意屬子中….

programme.title: 十字鎖喉手 / Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: 李成鷹的父親被多年好友凌豪設計所殺。李成鷹從父親身上學會“十字鎖喉手”的秘技，誓要為死去的父親報仇。於是，他潛入凌家作護衛，期間也巧遇失散多年的兄長，兩兄弟聯手大戰殺父仇人。.

programme.title: 大地兒女 / Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: 這是一部經典戰爭鉅片，描述抗日戰爭時人民的生活狀況。畫家俞瑞意外救了由鄉下被拐賣來的女子荷花。兩人互生情愫，不久更結為夫妻過著幸福的日子。無奈好景不常，不久日軍全面侵入中國，亦正式展開殘酷的統治….

programme.title: 文素臣 / The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: 「龍門七俠」之首文素臣命六俠入昭慶寺探察，他們不慎被主持明空殺害。明空更設計殺害林巡按，幸得文所救。文素臣潛入寺內與明空一戰為六俠報仇，林巡按下令官兵攻入昭慶寺，聯合文殲滅所有奸僧。.

programme.title: 邪完再邪 / Hex after Hex
programme.desc: 女鬼劉阿翠鍾情以前鄰居馬素，欲與其結合，央求父親攜同金銀珠寶向馬提親，撮合一段人鬼姻緣，馬素年青憨直，不願與鬼為伍，堅決拒絕，實則彼暗戀已有男友之鄰居紅卜卜，阿翠洞悉其情，決定伺機行動。.

programme.title: 廣東十虎與後五虎 / Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: 廣東十虎之一譚敏之侄譚聰，在賭館當巡場；一夜，十虎的徒弟及後人等四人，在賭場相聚時，旗人佟七帶著前清官之子小虎突襲，把譚聰殺死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、譚敏等，昔日曾把父殺死，以助反清義士蔡民義脫險。小虎遂與師叔們聯手，殺死仍在世的十虎及其後人、傳人，為父報仇...

programme.title: 梅山收七怪 / Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: 小哪吒偷吃了仙界桃樹的一個新結仙桃，但又不慎將另外七個仙桃弄落凡間，導致七隻不同動物變成妖怪。哪吒要在十天內收復妖怪，否則父親會被天帝懲罰。到底哪吒能否完成任務?

programme.title: 馬哥波羅 / Marco Polo
programme.desc: 故事描述東遊至中國的馬哥波羅，聽從元世祖忽必烈忠告，到中國各地考察三年，回京後，適逢忽遭反元志士刺殺，幸得蒙古高手護駕，一死一逃；馬憑死者遺言，判斷餘黨必在揚州；馬被任命為總督，率兵將反元者一網打盡；惟馬抵揚後，有感於漢人抗異族的無比決心，遂將蒙兵來攻之事暗告反元志士...

programme.title: 仙女下凡 / The Human Goddess
programme.desc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活，某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟，險遭不法之徒欺騙，幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼，七妹屢施法術相助，卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持，情愫漸生，共同守護孤兒院的未來。.

programme.title: 玉面飛狐 / The Silver Fox
programme.desc: 夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局掌門義子。司馬秋利慾薰心，設計弒殺師父，更以暗鏢毀去夏梧面容。重傷的夏梧懷抱年幼長女逃走，懷孕妻子卻於昏迷中遭司馬秋姦污。夏梧隱居深山，將仇恨寄託長女青青，苦心培育其成為武藝高強的「玉面飛狐」，命她下山劫鏢尋仇。.

programme.title: Malam Kelam Tania
programme.desc: Tania (Asha Assuncao) bertemu lagi dengan Rey (Anrez Adelio), orang yang telah menolongnya saat pulang ke rumah. Tania mengira Rey adalah tukang ojek, padahal Rey adalah wartawan yang sedang menyamar. Beberapa kejadian membuat Tania dan Rey sering dekat. Hingga muncul rasa suka, tapi suatu kejadian membuat Tania melupakan Rey.

programme.title: Si Paling Renang Cintanya Banyak Gaya
programme.desc: Seorang gadis cantik bernama Dinda (Shanice Margaretha) yang merupakan seorang atlet renang. Dinda yang akan mengikuti turnamen renang, harus masuk asrama untuk meningkatkan kemampuan renangnya. Di tempat tersebut, Dinda bertemu dengan Jordi (Fauzan Nasrul) yang merupakan atlet renang juga. Jordi yang tampan, banyak disukai para wanita. Kemudian, banyak kejadian yang semakin mendekatkan Dinda dan Jordi hingga tanpa mereka sadari, mereka berdua saling jatuh cinta. Masalah datang ketika sahabat dekat Dinda yang bernama Nisa, menyukai Jordi. Ia meminta agar Dinda mau mendekatkan Jordi kepadanya. Namun, Jordi tidak mau menerima cinta Nisa meski dipaksa Dinda karena Jordi sudah menyukai Dinda.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Kita Usahakan Bobol Rumah Itu
programme.desc: Demi bayar sks jadi pacar Ian!! Bella harus terima perjanjian agar masih bisa kuliah. Karjo ayah Bella kehilangan pekerjaan!! dia frustasi harus cari uang kemana lagi buat menghidupi keluarganya. Ide cemerlang datang dari Akmal adik Bella!! dia memberikan ide agar merampok rumah orang kaya tapi sayangnya mereka salah sasaran!! rumah yang dirampok mereka adalah rumah Ian si anak orang kaya. Apakah ian akan tau bahwa yang merampok rumahnya adalah keluarga bella?.

programme.title: Tour Guide Penggaet Hati

programme.title: Kita Usahakan Bobol Rumah Itu

programme.title: Naik Ranjang

programme.title: Kukira Kau Rumah Kosong
programme.desc: Kedua orang pemuda tampan bernama Niko dan Adit. Dua orang pemuda tersebut yang merupakan mahasiswa, bekerja di bengkel motor dan pelayan restoran, tapi mereka berlagak menjadi orang kaya. Niko dan Adit menyukai dua gadis bernama Fifi dan Rara, tapi pada pria tersebut berpura-pura menjadi orang kaya agar gadis impian mereka jatuh cinta. Masalah menjadi rumit saat kedua pria itu mengetahui bahwa Jaya memiliki seorang putri bernama Karina.

programme.title: Ketika Rela Tak Semudah Kata
programme.desc: Sambil menunggu panggilan kerja, Yudha yang tidak ingin ibunya tahu kalau ia telah kehilangan pekerjaannya, terpaksa menjadi pengamen. Meski demikian, Sheila terus menyemangatinya hingga Yudha merasa nyaman bersama Sheila. Di sisi lain, Yudha memiliki Siska, sahabat yang menyukai Yudha. Yudha pun dihadapkan dua pilihan antara Sheila dan Siska.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. programme.title: Jalan Cinta Cindy
programme.desc: Cindy (Rayna Snova) janjian dengan kekasihnya yang bernama Rama di sebuah restoran. Cindy berpikir di tempat romantis tersebut Rama akan melamarnya. Namun, harapan Cindy sirna saat mengetahui bahwa Rama mengajaknya bertemu karena Rama ingin memutuskan hubungan cintanya dengan Cindy. Mengetahui hal tersebut, hati Cindy sangat hancur. Ia pun termenung di tempat tersebut sambil memikirkan nasib hidupnya yang penuh kesedihan. Lalu, Cindy merasa ada seseorang yang sedang memotret dirinya. Ia pun marah kepada fotografer tersebut yang bernama Bobby (Agoye Mahendra). Bobby bilang kalau ia tidak bermaksud memfoto Cindy, tapi Cindy tidak terima

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Buku Harian Monalisa
programme.desc: Menceritakan tentang kehidupan seorang gadis bernama Monalisa (Azella Alhamid). Monalisa tinggal di rumahnya yang besar dan mewah bersama asisten rumah tangganya. Meski demikian, Monalisa sering menjadi korban bully di kampusnya. Pada suatu hari, Monalisa dikurung di dalam kamar mandi oleh teman-teman kuliahnya. Beruntung Aldo (Julian Jacob), temannya membantunya.Aldo mendobrak pintu kamar mandi hingga Monalisa akhirnya bisa keluar. Setelah itu, Monalisa langsung memeluk Aldo dengan erat. Tidak hanya itu, Aldo pun sering menyelamatkan Monalisa yang kerap menjadi bulan-bulanan di kampusnya karena penampilannya yang culun.

programme.title: Malam Kelam Tania

Hingga muncul rasa suka, tapi suatu kejadian membuat Tania melupakan Rey.

programme.title: Si Paling Renang Cintanya Banyak Gaya
programme.desc: Seorang gadis cantik bernama Dinda (Shanice Margaretha) yang merupakan seorang atlet renang. Dinda yang akan mengikuti turnamen renang, harus masuk asrama untuk meningkatkan kemampuan renangnya. Di tempat tersebut, Dinda bertemu dengan Jordi (Fauzan Nasrul) yang merupakan atlet renang juga. Jordi yang tampan, banyak disukai para wanita. Kemudian, banyak kejadian yang semakin mendekatkan Dinda dan Jordi hingga tanpa mereka sadari, mereka berdua saling jatuh cinta. Masalah datang ketika sahabat dekat Dinda yang bernama Nisa, menyukai Jordi. Ia meminta agar Dinda mau mendekatkan Jordi kepadanya. Namun, Jordi tidak mau menerima cinta Nisa meski dipaksa Dinda karena Jordi sudah menyukai Dinda.

Agung yang penuh kerja keras, bertemu Maya (Larasati Nugroho), seorang aktris yang membantu dan menjadi tempat ceritanya. Akankah Agung tetap kuat menghadapi ini? Apa hubungannya dengan Maya akan berkembang ke arah lebih serius?

programme.title: Izinkan Aku Mencintai Sendiri

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 18
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul
programme.desc: Bedu dan Adul adalah sebuah serial film animasi 3D tentang petualangan anak-anak di kawasan pinggiran Jakarta.

programme.title: Detektif Kubi
programme.desc: Rasa ingin tahu mendorong orang untuk belajar! Baru-baru ini, di Hutan Sinar Matahari, banyak hal aneh telah terjadi. Jadi orang-orang meminta bantuan Detektif Kubi. Detektif Kubi, bersama dengan teman-teman mudanya, menemukan petunjuk dalam permainan kata dan membantu teman-teman mereka di hutan untuk memecahkan kasus satu per satu.

programme.desc: Mega Series Terbaru Raden Rakha Dan Basmalah Gralind Di Indosiar Merangkai Kisah Indah Tayang Setiap Hari, Mulai Senin, 14 Juli 2025 Pukul 17:00 Wib. Dibintangi Raden Rakha, Basmalah Gralind, Panji Saputra, Tsania Marwa, Gita Sinaga, Vayala Maulidina, Washifa, Haura Lathifa, Dan Emiliano Cortizo. programme.desc: Program berita yang menyajikan rangkuman berita-berita penting dan terkini yang terjadi di dalam dan luar negeri. Dari politik, ekonomi, hukum, hingga peristiwa sosial dan olahraga, semua dikupas tuntas di sini.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Preman Pensiun Deui
programme.desc: Pensiunnya Bahar (pemimpin preman) dan kekacauan yang terjadi di wilayah kekuasaannya setelah ia menyerahkan urusan pada tangan kanannya, Muslihat, yang kemudian mencoba mengambil alih, memicu konflik dengan anak buah seperti Jamal dan Komar, memaksa Bahar turun tangan lagi untuk menyelesaikan masalah dan mengembalikan ketertiban, seperti kasus tanah di kampung dan penahanan Jamal.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Mencintaimu Sekali Lagi Arini (Rr)
programme.desc: Arini, seorang penata rias sukses yang digemari para selebritas papan atas, mengalami patah hati saat memergoki kekasihnya berselingkuh dengan sahabatnya sendiri. Sempat kehilangan kepercayaan pada cinta, ia bertemu dengan Lingga yang perlahan memikat hatinya. Namun, masalah muncul ketika Emil, saudara laki-laki Lingga, juga jatuh hati padanya.

programme.title: Go Spot Eksklusif
programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Film dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan selama moment liburan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Catatan Hati Seorang Isti (Rr)
programme.desc: Hana (Dewi Sandra), seorang penulis buku yang sering menceritakan pengalaman hidupnya dan para sahabat. Hana hidup harmonis bersama suaminya, Bram (Ashraf Sinclair), dan putri mereka, Rosi. Kehidupan mereka yang tampak sempurna mulai diuji ketika Hana menemukan pesan mesra dari sosok misterius bernama Hello Kitty yang dikirimkan kepada suaminya. Hana terjebak dalam keraguan apakah suaminya yang lembut dan perhatian tega mengkhianati cinta mereka.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Pengantin Lelaki Untuk Cik Gadis
programme.desc: Yasmin cuba memburukan Salsa dihadapan para pekerja lain sehingga Salsa berasa sangat malu. Kris memberi amaran kepada Yasmin supaya tidak mengganggu Salsa lagi.
